title: Channel card: meter
comments: 8-segment peak meter, louder of L/R, pre-fader (decision 43); thresholds re +4 dBu peak
-30 -20 -10 -5 0 +3 +6 dB and CLIP at +10 dB (+14 dBu, soft-clip onset)
Attack 1 ms (1k into C401), fall 20 dB in about 1.5 s (R409 680k)
LEDs from +5 V into LM339 outputs; LM339 ground is PGND
